{{Quote|They are afraid, Supreme Chancellor. Many have heard reports of the demonstrations, even violent activity near this very building. The separatists&mdash;|Uv Gizen to Palpatine|<ref name="AotC noveliation" />}}
'''Uv Gizen''' was an individual who served as an [[Aide/Legends|aide]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]'s [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]. During a meeting of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] shortly before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], Uv told Palpatine that he believed that the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] were afraid since many protests were pushed forward, but was interrupted by the Chancellor before [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] tried to call for order among the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]]s.<ref name="AotC noveliation" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Uv Gizen is the name given in the script of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] for the character that became [[Sly Moore/Legends|Sly Moore]]. In the film's novelization by [[R. A. Salvatore]], Gizen replaces Moore's role, while Moore doesn't appear at all.<ref name="AotC noveliation" />
